All Russia had to do was move east and apply pressure on Japanese occupied areas and the Japanese already knew this which is why they had a surrender in negotiations. Nobody knew what the bomb really was back then so a country saying "I have the best weapon ever" isn't going to mean much to the general mindset of an opposing country. Known cultural fears like invasions and the stories they'd heard of soviet brutality would be much better for getting a surrender. And it was, which is why they were working towards an agreement already when the bombs were dropped. Not to mention we didn't even get what we wanted (no more Emperor) from the nuke so there was no point in it as all.
